text:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Release cutover v2.12.0 -> canary (50%) to inference-prod-us-west. Observed sudden spike of Unready pods and CrashLoopBackOff on encoder pods. HPA reacted and scaled down mid-cutover. Request 503s increased ~7% :rotating_light:
sre-oncall: i'm paged, grabbing context and logs. starting incident timeline.
carla: seeing ~5k 503s in last 3m on /v1/generate - two enterprise tenants reporting timeouts. linking dashboards: https://dash/redwood/inference-prod-us-west
matt: can we pause the rollout? where's the feature flag toggle for encoder v2?
jess: flag is `enable_v2_encoder`. admin UI available or API: `curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/flags/enable_v2_encoder -d '{"value":false}'`
sre-oncall: killing flag now to stop traffic to canary. running api call...
ops-bot: flag toggle request accepted (200).
sre-oncall: confirmed -> traffic should stop shifting to canary, scaling changes incoming.
carla: runbook step: if crashloop on canary, revert image or scale up stable.
matt: also bumping HPA minReplicas to avoid oscillation while we stabilize: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa encoder-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'`
ops-bot: HPA patch applied. minReplicas set to 4.
sre-oncall: increasing nodegroup desired count +2 as precaution: `eksctl scale nodegroup --cluster prod --name workers-usw --nodes 10`
jess: after flag kill, downstream error rate dropping. 503s down from 7% -> 1.2% in ~45s.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by manual override. Canary replicas terminating. Stable service now receiving full traffic.
carla: quick sanity check: encoder-canary pods had OOMKilled in last restart log. suspect resource request mismatch in new manifest. grabbing pod logs: ```
kubectl -n inference logs encoder-canary-7f6d -c encoder
... java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
```
matt: noted. will open a PR to adjust resources and add a liveness/readiness buffer for canary.
sre-oncall: no active customer escalations yet. support notified to watch top customer tenants. will keep paging if regression recurs.
ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: INC-2026-3492. severity: P2.
jess: starting a canary postmortem checklist: capture manifest diffs, image digest, HPA metrics, node drain timeline, and flag change timestamps.
oncall-l2: taking handoff for deeper investigation. I'll pick this up overnight, correlate kube-apiserver events and node autoscaler logs, will follow up with root cause and remediation plan in the morning.
sre-oncall: thanks — leaving notes in the incident doc and scheduled a quick sync at 09:00 UTC for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
